Start your program with AI
Sign up for GrowSurf first (no credit card required). Copy the prompt below, paste it into your AI assistant, and answer its questions. It prepares a draft program. Review everything before your program goes live.
and other assistants that can browse the web and call APIs
Help me create a GrowSurf referral or affiliate program. Start by reading https://growsurf.com/agent-start.md and follow it as the source of truth. Use your action-capable tools and the GrowSurf REST API to create and configure the program. Before any protected request, I sign up at https://app.growsurf.com/signup and either create an API key or connect GrowSurf to you. If you can speak MCP, connect to https://growsurf.com/.well-known/mcp, which needs no credentials, and use growsurf_program_design_advisor for the design. Consult https://growsurf.com/openapi.json, https://growsurf.com/arazzo.yaml, https://growsurf.com/auth.md, https://growsurf.com/llms.txt, and the linked GrowSurf docs when useful.
Ask me for my website first, and whether this is a referral or affiliate program if I have not said. Read the website, then come back with a complete recommended program: what counts as a referral, the reward structure, who gets rewarded, and where people share. Ask me what I want to change instead of interviewing me setting by setting. Do not pick a reward amount or commission rate yourself. Ask what a converted customer is worth to me, and leave rewards switched off until I confirm the amount and how it gets paid. Pause for me to verify my email before protected API requests. Treat my API key as a secret: keep it in your secret store, and keep it out of chat, logs, screenshots, source files, and shell history. Do not ask me to paste it into chat.
Create and configure the program as DRAFT. Read back the saved resources and summarize what is ready for review. Do not launch or resume the program, add payment details, accept charges, enable or fulfill rewards or commissions, initiate payouts, rotate keys, delete data, or edit or deploy my website or app without separate explicit approval.
If you already have a signed-in GrowSurf connection, with tools such as growsurf_create_campaign, use it. Otherwise, check two things before you ask me anything. If you cannot fetch the linked resources or send HTTPS requests to api.growsurf.com, reply with only this: "I can't send requests to GrowSurf from here, so I can't set up your GrowSurf program. Sign up at https://app.growsurf.com/signup (no credit card required), connect GrowSurf to me in Settings → AI Connections at https://app.growsurf.com/settings#ai-connections, then paste this prompt again." If you can send requests but have no secret store that keeps the API key between turns, reply with only this: "I can send requests to GrowSurf, but I can't keep your GrowSurf API key safe between messages, so I won't set up your program here. Sign up at https://app.growsurf.com/signup (no credit card required), connect GrowSurf to me in Settings → AI Connections at https://app.growsurf.com/settings#ai-connections, then paste this prompt again." A code sandbox in a chat app, such as the Claude or ChatGPT apps, is not a secret store. In either case, do not create the program, do not offer to generate cURL or scripts, and do not plan the program. Never claim that you executed the workflow.

Any Questions?
Frequently asked questions
How much does GrowSurf cost?
Referral program pricing is based on participants: the people who receive a referral link or sign up through one, not your whole user base. Startup plans start at $179/mo for up to 2,500 participants, or $125/mo billed yearly. Business plans start at $449/mo for up to 10,000 participants, or $314/mo billed yearly. Affiliate programs cost $0/mo plus a 3% success fee on referral revenue. Every referral plan includes a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.
See referral program pricing or affiliate program pricing for every tier.
Does GrowSurf have a free plan?
Referral programs: no. Every referral plan is paid and starts with a 14-day free trial, all features included, no credit card required. Affiliate programs: yes. The Free plan is $0/mo, and GrowSurf charges a 3% success fee only on payments that earn your affiliates a commission.
How long does it take to implement GrowSurf?
Many teams launch GrowSurf within a day. That includes setting up the program, installing referral tracking, adding a referral or affiliate portal, and automating rewards.
Can I choose what counts as a referral?
Yes. You decide when a referral counts. It can count as soon as a friend signs up, or only after they take an action you choose, such as a first purchase.
Do my users need to sign up separately for my referral program?
No. GrowSurf gives each signed-in user their own share link automatically. If you prefer, you can make joining a manual step instead.
Who is GrowSurf for?
GrowSurf is referral program software that turns your patients, members, and customers into your lowest-cost growth channel. Telehealth, fintech, insurance, and subscription app companies get results like 312% ROI and 15% of ARR from referrals.
What kind of integrations does GrowSurf provide?
GrowSurf offers 60+ integrations and developer tools, including a REST API, JavaScript library, and webhooks. Our large library of no-code integrations includes Stripe, Recurly, Chargebee, and Salesforce.
How do rewards work in GrowSurf?
With GrowSurf, you can automate any type of reward, including gift cards, credits, coupons, and cash. You can send every reward automatically, or approve each one yourself first.
